title: Suddhikam
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || Tatra || voca || || [page 250] 250 GANDHABBAKĀYA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXI. 1. 3 3 Gandhabbakāyike vo bhikkhave deve desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || 4 Katame ca bhikkhave gandhabbakāyikā devā || || Santi bhikkhave mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave sāragandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pheggugandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave tacagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave papatikagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pattagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pupphagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave phalagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave rasagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave gandhagandhe adhivatthā devā || || 5 Ime vuccanti bhikkhave gandhabbakāyikā devā ti || ||
